title: Expose encoder capability report in settings workspace
summary: Expose existing encoder capability diagnostic artifacts as bounded read-only evidence in the Settings workspace.
reason: Phase 6 had a backend-owned -DumpEncoderCapabilitiesPath diagnostic, but broader Local API settings surfaces could not yet see the existing report. This threads the evidence into /api/settings/workspace without probing tools or changing encode selection.
behavior_before: The encoder capability report could be generated by PowerShell diagnostics, but /api/settings/workspace did not expose whether the report existed or summarize its selected encoder availability evidence.
behavior_after: /api/settings/workspace includes read-only encoder_capability_report evidence. It summarizes an existing State/Progress/encoder_capabilities.json report when present, and reports missing, malformed, or oversized reports as non-blocking review evidence. The settings route does not run FFmpeg, generate diagnostics, filter choices, or affect encode selection.
tests_added: Added settings policy tests for missing, valid, and malformed encoder capability reports.
Extended the Local API settings workspace route test to assert read-only encoder_capability_report exposure.
rollback_plan: Remove settings_encoder_capability_report, remove encoder_capability_report from SettingsWorkspaceDto and SettingsFacadeMixin, revert the focused tests and docs/inventory updates, then refresh generated summaries.
